meta.title: Savings Calculation: Add Custom Reference and save
gaps: The exact label or locator of the newly opened custom-reference input is not specified in the catalog.
The underlying persisted storage record cannot be inspected directly; persistence is checked by reopening the draft and reading the displayed reference.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The exact label or locator of the newly opened custom-reference input is not specified in the catalog.; The underlying persisted storage record cannot be inspected directly; persistence is checked by reopening the draft and reading the displayed reference.

steps.note: Open the Events list to locate the existing saved draft.
Switch to the Drafts tab required by the case.
Open the first saved draft and land on its create screen.
Confirm the Savings Calculation window opened.
Open the custom reference entry control.
Enter the requested custom reference; the exact field label is not cataloged.
Verify that saving closes the Savings Calculation window.
Leave the draft and reopen it to check that the reference persisted.
Open the draft's Savings section again.
Assert that the saved custom reference is displayed after reopening the draft.
